svg.aria-label: Hushpad in action: a call starts and Hushpad offers to take notes; the notes list decisions and action items; the transcript shows who said what; all meetings in one list. Every meeting shown is invented.

g.text: Meeting notes that stay on your Mac.
A call starts. One click and you're taking notes.
Afterwards: what was decided, and who does what.
Every word transcribed on your Mac. Audio never leaves it.
All your meetings, as plain files you keep.
